Mapping the EXREPO Shared Drive

Staff can map the EXREPO shared drive for team documents.

Windows

  • Open File Explorer and choose Map network drive.
  • Enter the path \\exrepo.example.test\shared.
  • Sign in with your example account.

Mac

In Finder choose Go, then Connect to Server, and enter smb://exrepo.example.test/shared.
